David's horrified when Stephen reveals he's moving in with Audrey to look after her. But what's he after? Convinced Toyah killed Imran, Saira turns on her daughter-in-law.

In the wake of Phill and Fiz's wedding day drama last week, Fiz is left wondering she's done the right thing... How will things pan out between Fiz, Phill and Tyrone? Sarah tries to persuade Carla to use Stephen's silk in the factory. Aadi is shocked when he spots Kelly with a wodge of cash. Tim wants to give Sally a birthday surprise.

Having been trolled on social media, Maria freaks out when she fears she's being followed... A family lunch goes pear-shaped for the Platts, who row about Audrey's money. After asking Ty for advice, Phill turns up at the factory and makes a romantic but clumsy stab at winning Fiz back. Tim hopes for a return to normal in the bedroom.

Gary tries to stop Kelly from tracking down her dead dad's clients and repaying their money but she refuses to listen to him. Is the teenager putting herself in danger? Ed is given an electric shock when he does some work at Debbie's hotel. Abi's hurt when she reads Wendy's notes about her parenting. Sean's son Dylan arrives.

Tyrone is given some painful home truths as he and Fiz attend their first couples therapy session, while still trying to keep their relationship a secret from Phill. Gary's left reeling when he learns Kelly's been taken and her kidnapper wants £50k for her safe return! Wendy turns up at No.1 to clear the air with ex-lover Ken.

Phill's left red-faced at the factory when he tries to woo machinist Fiz by dressing up as Richard Gere from the film An Officer and a Gentleman, only to do his back in! Gary reveals his true colours when he sees red and turns violent with Kelly's kidnappers.. With Audrey still in a huff with her family, can they win her round?

Things unravel for Fiz when Phill insists on going to couples therapy and books the same therapist that she and Tyrone are seeing! Is he about to find out the truth? It's Audrey's birthday, but she's not impressed by her celebration meal or her surprise present. Elsewhere, a shaken Kelly quizzes Gary on his violent behaviour.

Phill finally signs the form and annuls his marriage to Fiz. Stressed-out Kev is furious when Jack's school calls to report his son has punched someone. Later, the pair row. Stu visits his long-lost daughter, Bridget, but lies to Yasmeen about it. Summer tells Billy that she's definitely not going to uni. In hospital, Audrey's quizzed about the pills.

Under pressure thanks to Jack being bullied and Abi due home any day, Kevin loses his temper at the garage and attacks Stephen's car with a wrench! Yasmeen is impressed when Stu comes up with an idea to sell the restaurant leftovers at knockdown prices to people in need. Audrey makes a decision about the salon.

Kevin prepares for Abi's return but is shocked when the police turn up to talk about the incident with Stephen's car. Can he stop Abi finding out what happened? Debbie admits to Ronnie that she's so skint she's left with two options, bankruptcy or an insurance job. Summer rejects Aaron's advances. Tim and Sally plan a night out.

Debbie tries to solve her money woes by getting Ryan to stage a break-in at the Bistro… Although she has a change of heart, Ryan goes ahead and empties the safe.. Tim and Sally's marriage hits a new low when Sally finds him watching porn and kicks him out of their bedroom! Lonely Ken reaches out to his ex-lover Wendy.

Ryan's in trouble as Ed reveals the CCTV won't have been affected by the 'power cut. When Ryan's arrested, will he drop Debbie in it or will she persuade him to keep shtum? Yasmeen and Stu's story has a journalist enthralled. George receives a huge cash offer for his business. Todd finds out and confronts him, but is George selling?

With his story on the front page of The Gazette, Stu is visited by his ex-wife Lucy, who drops a bombshell about his past that pushes shocked Yasmeen to boot him out. George's feisty sister Glenda arrives in Weatherfield in the nick of time... Daniel finds out Leo's been keeping something from Jenny. Angry Nick threatens Ryan

The fallout from Debbie's insurance scam continues as Craig confirms the CCTV footage is enough to send Ryan down. But Ryan comes up with a dodgy new plan... Having read all about Stu's shocking past on social media, Kelly finds him drunk and barely conscious! Elsewhere, Daisy tries to persuade Jenny to move to Canada.

At No.6, Stu is determined that Yasmeen hears the truth. But Yasmeen makes an SOS call to Zeedan, and Stu ends up arrested for breach of the peace. After a bit of meddling from Glenda and George, Sean bags a date with Laurence, who he met at the wake. Meanwhile, Ryan awaits his sentencing at court...

Toyah finds herself in bed with Spider and ends up full of guilt and regret. But when Spider takes a mysterious call, it's clear he's hiding something... Spider isn't the only one with something to hide when Stephen pays for a posh afternoon tea for Audrey using a credit card in the name of a Mrs Gabrielle Reid...

When fellow protester Griff introduces himself to Toyah, Spider tries to convince her he's a loose cannon. Meanwhile, Leanne accuses Spider of leading Toyah astray. Audrey's birthday tea with her friends turns into a bit of a damp squib when she announces she recently tried to kill herself, just as the waiter arrives with the cake!

Zeedan discovers Stu could be released within days and asks Adam to request his old case files to prove his innocence. But his efforts don't go down well with Yasmeen. Stephen's baffled by Audrey's change of heart about reopening the salon. But will she admit to her suicide attempt? In the Rovers, Faye makes a pass at Michael!

Summer's exam results are in and aren't exactly great. But things only get worse when she has a diabetic emergency and collapses, which throws Aaron into a panic. Adam tells Zeedan he can access Stu's case files but it will cost £1,200! Stephen plays dirty to make sure he and Max are hired to update Underworld's website.
Alya and Zeedan make an intriguing discovery in Stu's case files. Stephen pits Sarah and Carla against each other. Summer lies to Billy about her diabetes nurse's advice.
Carla is resistant to involving Stephen in Underworld. Yasmeen supports Stu's return to the street. Kelly and Aadi get to know each other intimately.
Kelly and Aadi struggle to distinguish fact from fiction. Bernie's shopping expedition results in double trouble with a woman called Fern. Tim and Elaine question Yasmeen's trust in Stu.

Maria, Gary and Dev reel as Aadi and Kelly's engagement news makes the local paper. As the adults agree the two are too young to marry, Aadi vows to leave home. At Speed Daal, Summer is celebrating her 18th and is given a letter written by her dad, who died years ago. Dylan tells Sean he doesn't want to return to London.

As Audrey reopens the salon, she finally tells her family that she tried to take her own life. Stephen is floored when she reveals she's made a decision about her will. Jenny tells younger man Leo she does not want to stand in the way of his future. Elsewhere, Dev is relieved when Aadi returns his mum's engagement ring.

Having split up with Leo, Jenny drowns her sorrows and becomes a target for gold digger Stephen. As they kiss, Leo returns to the Rovers with an engagement ring... Toyah tries to stop Carla making a bad business decision and receives a warning from Spider. Ken tries to persuade his exlover Wendy to rekindle their friendship.

Sarah tells Stephen that she has arranged a meeting with a couple of potential investors; and Jenny is feeling the pressure as she meets with the pub’s charity football team, knowing the Flying Horse are looking for revenge.

Carla is unimpressed to see that Griff is chatting to Toyah; Stephen lets himself into No 8 and takes out the trust fund papers so that he can practice Audrey’s signature; and there is a heartstopping finale to the football match.
Saira approaches Toyah and accuses her of murdering Imran; and James is told he will be fitted with an ICD to prevent further cardiac arrests.

As her trial looms, Toyah's guilt gets the better of her, and she secretly confesses to Spider that she intended to kill Imran! But Leanne hears Toyah's every word! Ahead of their escape to Greta Green, teens Kelly and Aadi throw an engagement party to prove how serious they are about each other. But will Dev give his blessing?

Ryan tells Alya how he regrets taking the money from the Bistro and begs her for a second chance. Meanwhile, Sean has a very unwelcome surprise at his birthday party. Gary and Maria try to hide their fears over Kelly's wedding. But the mask soon slips when a hurt Kelly overhears Maria saying unkind things about her fiancé Aadi.

Jenny prepares to say goodbye to her beloved pub, the Rovers, by appointing a new manager. Meanwhile, Toyah awaits the jury's verdict. Will she be found guilty? When Sharon arrives for Kelly's engagement party, Gary panics that Kelly will find out he killed her dad! Unable to bear the lies any longer, will Sharon reveal the truth?

Having found out that Gary killed her dad, Rick, Kelly plots her revenge by offering her kidnapper Kieron £10,000 to have Gary bumped off! Will he agree? When the sinkhole at the Platts' becomes an issue, Audrey offers them a place to stay. But when Leo clocks Stephen's unease, he begins to suspect something isn't right...

Kelly's plan unfolds as Gary's knocked unconscious and thrown in Kieron's van. Later, at the woods where he killed Rick, Gary's instructed to dig his own grave... Audrey arrives back from a spa day early to find a valuer from the estate agency at her house, and discovers Stephen made the appointment! Is Stephen's game finally up?

With the plot to kill Gary unraveling fast, unhinged Kieron sets his sights on killing Kelly and framing her for Gary's death, making it look like a murder and suicide! When David finds out what Stephen's been up to, he considers calling the police. Gabrielle turns up at Audrey's - will she tell Stephen's family everything about her ex?

Leo's like a dog with a bone on his mission to prove Stephen's a liar and confronts him on the factory gantry, threatening to tell Audrey everything! How will Stephen react? Following last week's dramatic shooting, the police intensify their enquiries. As James recovers from his surgery, the footy star has to reconsider his career in sport.

Ever since his run-in with Stephen, Leo's nowhere to be seen. Has he got cold feet about his relationship with Jenny and done a sudden bunk on his older-woman fiancée? Dee-Dee returns from America to sort out James' pay-off from Weatherfield County and tries to get him a better deal. Meanwhile, James gives Lily her first football lesson.

Leo's dad, Teddy, spots Jenny behind the bar of the Rovers and tells her she only has herself to blame for Leo leaving! Dev pours his heart out to Bernie about Aadi. Having tackled the club about James' paltry pay-off, Dee-Dee sets her sights on clearing Stu's name and finds an address for the officer originally in charge of the case!

Stu is delighted to meet his granddaughter Eliza and daughter Bridget. After Lucy breaks up the reunion, Alya accuses her of hiding vital information linked to Stu's case. The Baileys bid an emotional farewell to James, who lands a coaching job in London. Glenda takes over the quiz at the Rovers when Jenny falls over and hurts herself.

Stu wants to move on from the past but Alya has other ideas and fails to inform Dee-Dee. When Eliza turns up at Speed Daal, Alya seizes a potentially huge opportunity... Aaron finds his dad's weed stash and uses it in a brownie recipe! Billy's horrified when he finds Summer and Aaron high as kites just as the bishop is due to visit...

Aaron's given a beating by his dad Eric. When Paul hears about the weed, he confronts Aaron, who punches him... Wendy tells besotted Ken she has feelings for him, too. David and Shona are thrilled when Max gets a good report. Tim gives Aggie a necklace to thank her for helping him buy Sally an anniversary gift. Is Aggie catching feelings for Tim?
Ken's efforts to keep Wendy a secret from Tracy prove futile, Eric's confession leaves Aaron heartbroken, and Max's hopes for a fresh start are dashed.
Stu's account of his time in prison upsets Bridget, David accuses Max of trolling Maria, and Tracy cooks up a punishment for Wendy and Ken.
Alya and Dee-Dee are stunned by the DNA test results, Nick and Leanne hear from an old adversary, and Tim and Aggie are caught out by Sally.
Leanne lies to Nick in order to pay Harvey a visit in prison, Sally makes another upsetting discovery about Tim, and Fern masquerades as Bernie to secure a lucrative job.
Fern frames Bernie for an ambitious theft, Chesney finds a positive pregnancy test in Gemma's pocket, and Audrey gives Sam some words of wisdom.
Expectant Summer receives an unexpected offer, Bernie struggles to convince the police of her innocence, and Stephen panics when Teddy decides to report Leo's disappearance.

Stephen panics when Jenny and Teddy go on a mission to find Leo, especially when Teddy says he's planning on travelling to Canada to speak to his son face to face! Summer tells Aaron she's going to have an abortion, but is stung when Billy hints at his disapproval. Eileen gets knocked unconscious after a nasty accident involving a pumpkin!

Convinced he's about to get his hands on Audrey's equity-release money, Stephen makes plans to leave. But Audrey makes an announcement that leaves him reeling... It's the anniversary of Sinead's death, but when Bertie calls Daisy *Mummy', Daisy gets cold feet about her future with Daniel. Fiz worries when Ty takes up taekwondo!

Fiz is left feeling seriously stressed out when she learns The Gazette is planning to serialise a book about John Stape in the paper. Is Phill behind it? Stephen's in a spin over Audrey's plans to use her equity-release money for a trip to Canada with Sam. To what lengths will he go to stop her?
Tyrone shows Fiz the first extract from the John Stape book in the Gazette. Todd is shocked by a picture on Laurence's phone, and Tracy gets bogged down by house repairs.
Summer meets Mike and Esther at a private hospital and agrees to let them adopt her baby. Fiz and Tyrone read the second instalment of the John Stape book in the Gazette.
Summer's deceit fuels Billy's fears for her health, Hope betrays Sam's confidence, and Adam attempts to succeed where Daniel fails.

Realising how desperate Sam is to visit Harvey in prison, Leanne urges Nick to give in to his son's demands as it might give him closure. What will Nick decide? Seeing red when the writer of the John Stape book implies Fiz was complicit in her husband's crimes, Tyrone punches him and gets arrested for assault.

Fiz and Tyrone tell a devastated Hope that the book will be published and Tyrone finds himself in serious trouble. Later, Hope says that she wants to stay with Chesney. Bernie tracks down Fern's ex-husband, Howard, and tells him Fern is framing her for a robbery. After revealing that Fern is a con artist, will Howard agree to help Bernie?

To prevent people reading the book, Tyrone buys all the copies from the local bookshop but Hope stumbles across them in the backyard. How will she react? Billy calls on Summer while Mike and Esther are visiting to talk about the baby. Will he discover the truth? Dee-Dee takes Stu for his court hearing, what will the outcome be?

It looks like Bernie's finally tracked down Fern, but when she goes to confront her lookalike, she's bundled into the back of a van with a bag on her head! Is she in danger? Hope admits that reading the John Stape book made her realise how much she has in common with her dad. Debbie tells Nick she's selling her half of the Bistro.

There's delight for Stu and Yasmeen when a social worker visits No.6 and tells them Eliza can move in immediately. Gemma starts to get suspicious of Howard. When Nick and Leanne make Debbie a low offer for her half of the Bistro, will she be forced to accept it? Griff's agenda becomes clear at a community-centre meeting.

Leanne drops a bombshell on a shocked Nick, telling him Harvey has agreed for Sam to visit him in prison. Roy and Brian warn David that Max needs protection from Griff. Eliza is subdued after she visits her mum in jail, but Yasmeen reassures Stu that Eliza is lucky to have him. Toyah is worried about Spider's involvement with Griff.

While visiting Harvey in prison, Sam interrogates his mum's killer, who admits to intending to murder Leanne. Harvey is clearly rattled by Sam's questions and visit. Fiz and Ty confront Hope over the missing books. Later, Hope joins a group chat called Legacy of Evil and tells her classmates she's planning a 'special tribute' to John Stape.

Hope takes a hammer into school. When she overhears two girls calling her names, she rushes towards them with her weapon. What will the consequences be? In the community centre, Ken is stunned when Nigel introduces him to an actor friend who turns out to be his ex Martha Fraser! Will they rekindle their romance?

When Sam, Nick and Leanne visit Harvey in prison, the killer tells Nick he will give him the cash to buy the Bistro. Will Nick make a deal with the devil? Summer tells Aaron that they can't let Billy find out about the baby and says that the only way to keep the secret is to move somewhere else until after she's given birth.

After deciding to move in with Mike and Esther, Summer starts bleeding and suffers a miscarriage. Meanwhile, Aaron's dad has had a relapse and is drinking again... Hearing that the dry rot in the Bistro will cost £20k to fix, Nick lies to Leanne and says they can use the money Sam inherited from Natasha. But is everything as it seems?

When Drake laughs at Stephen's lowly delivery job, he quits and tries to convince Nick that Audrey is drinking again. Later, he prepares to spike Audrey's drink... When Todd urges Sean not to give up on Laurence, Sean leaves a message on his phone. But when a drunk Laurence turns up at the Rovers. Todd has to help him into a cab.

Summer and Aaron feel guilty when they see that Mike and Esther have redecorated their spare room for Summer and must decide whether to come clean about what's happened. After begging for his food-delivery job back, Stephen is mugged on his rounds. When he sees Elaine approaching, he tries to escape on the moped but loses control.

Tim is concerned that Stephen is taking Audrey for a ride. Gail and Audrey pressure Stephen to invest £10k in Sarah's business idea. Will he admit he doesn't have the cash? When the school counsellor quizzes Fiz and Tyrone about their family, Ty decides to make things official and pops the question! But their celebrations soon get interrupted.

Hope decides to hold a seance to contact her dad and, in the midst of it, discovers a bag of his things. As she, Joseph and Sam stare at John's photos, they all freak out. Determined to get his hands on her cash, Stephen tricks Elaine into thinking he's being abused by his ex. Elaine says she understands and wants to help.
Griff exploits his injury to further his agenda, Adam and Sarah cause headaches for Stephen, and Tyrone plots a surprise Christmas wedding for Fiz.

When Mike and Esther drop Summer at the hospital for her scan, Mike wants to go in with her. Summer and Aaron play for time, but it seems their lies might catch up with them. Hearing that Martha is leaving for Hull, Ken needs to decide whether he wants to be with Martha or Wendy. Then he's stunned whon Marina asks himto come winer.

After finding a lump in her breast, Daisy is in bits. Jenny urges Daisy to tell her boyfriend Daniel, who pledges his support, promising to go to the doctor's with her. Simon loses his job but when Caria takes him on at Underworld, Leanne realises he'll be working with Jacob. Fiz walks in on Gemma trying on the wedding dress!

Terrified Daisy heads in to see Dr Gaddas on her own when panicked Daniel chooses to drink instead. When Peter has a word, will Daniel turn up and make things right? Billy is determined to stop Summer committing to the surrogacy plan and threatens to report Mike and Esther to the police if they don't back off. How will Summer react?

Shocked to learn that Damon is Jacob's dad, Amy persuades the pair to meet up. But Jacob's resentful that Damon was in Ibiza while he was mixed up in gangs. Damon fumes to hear that Harvey got his son involved in drug crime. Worried Billy and Paul report Summer to the police as a missing person. Adam intervenes in a bid to get Daniel and Daisy back on track.

Having been blindsided by Damon, Nick's forced to go behind Leanne's back and give Jacob a job in the Bistro. But how long before she discovers the truth about Nick's dealings? Daniel accompanies Daisy to her follow-up appointment. David is horrified when taken-in Max goes camping with Griff but the survival trip goes horribly wrong.

At No.1, Steve, Tracy, Daniel and Daisy are horrified when they realise all the presents have gone from under the Christmas tree, including the engagement ring Daniel's bought for Daisy! Spider begs Toyah to keep his huge secret. While Fiz worries about Christmas, Tyrone shares a secret smile with their girls. George excitedly waits for Eileen's present to arrive.
Tyrone's wedding surprise backfires when Fiz suffers a breakdown, Max fails to appreciate David's sense of humour, and Daniel gets a helping hand with his proposal

As Stephen's lies start to catch up with him, Gail confronts him. Is it the end of the road for the killer? David's horrified when Max says he's moving to Griff's. Sam finds Hope talking to her dead dad.

Sarah's business plan crumbles due to Stephen's lack of funds. Jenny reveals Teddy has new intel on Leo.Toyah warns David to get Max away from Griff, who's very dangerous. Todd makes a pass at Laurence.

As Stephen intervenes to stop Teddy telling Jenny what he's discovered about Leo, Teddy is run over! Todd apologises to Sean for trying to kiss Laurence. Billy tries to stop Summer becoming a surrogate.
With Teddy unconscious, is Stephen's problem solved? Todd looks into the death of Laurence's wife.Summer has a serious talk with Billy. Nina urges technophobe Roy to use the mobile she's got him.
When Teddy takes a turn for the worse, Stephen's thrilled and feeds Jenny a pack of lies about Leo. Carla's underwhelmed by Peter's dull New Year's plan. Billy hopes Aaron will make Summer see sense.
Nina's left fighting for life when she goes looking for uncontactable Roy and falls into a river... Teddy makes a recovery. Summer demands answers from skint Mike and Esther.
Maria rebrands the Christmas market a Peace Festival. Spider is lured into danger by Max...Jenny offers Teddy a room at the Rovers. Todd is suspicious of Mike and Esther. Roy goes digital.
Max panics when Griff warns Lauren to steer clear of the Peace Festival. What has Griff got planned? Gemma and Bernie stage a sit-in at Joseph's school. Damon makes a dodgy demand of Jacob...
Damon instructs Jacob to accept a special delivery, Daisy enquires about a wedding venue, Spider discharges himself from hospital, and David hurries to protect Max from Griff.
Jacob panics when police turn up at the bistro, Daisy resolves to secure a prestigious DJ for her wedding, and Maria clashes with Len on live television.
A troubling discovery about Mike and Esther leads Summer into danger, Damon orders Jacob to get out of town, and Daisy receives flowers from an admirer.
Mike's actions land Summer in hospital, Fiz and Tyrone get an earful of Hope's Stape tape, and Amy makes an announcement regarding Jacob.
Paul seeks revenge for Mike's treatment of Summer, Ryan gives Nick an insight into the real Damon, and Daniel plots a thoughtful surprise for Daisy.
A triggered memory places Teddy in Stephen's firing line, Daisy makes a blunder in her bid to fight back, and Gemma decides to offer a child-minding service.
Sarah alerts Stephen to the existence of the factory's CCTV, Daisy receives two unwelcome visitors at the Rovers and Chesney unveils his business idea to Gemma.
Maria's life depends on Max taking timely action, Evelyn suspects Tyrone of playing away again and Justin and Christina give Daisy double trouble.
Max faces the consequences of his recent actions, Hope's good deed for Kirk ends in tragedy and Daniel encourages Daisy to make peace with Christina.
David vows to get Max the best defence that money can buy, Daisy sets out to wangle some freebies for her wedding and Hope resolves to avenge the death of Cilla.
Daisy attends a wedding fair to forget her troubles, Hope accuses Beth of slapping her and Nick feels uneasy as Damon gets comfortable in the bistro.
Daisy receives a sample of her wedding invitation, Sean books Todd an emergency appointment with Laurence and Dev is downhearted when Bernie thrashes him at golf.
A stranger gives Todd a word of warning regarding Laurence, Ryan and Sam panic when masked gunmen enter the bistro, and Dev attempts to appear pleased by Bernie's success.
Nick orders Damon to collect his drugs or else, Eileen and Todd hear a shocking allegation against Laurence, and Sarah tells Adam that having a baby is not her priority.
Stephen comes to the rescue when Sarah and Michael's client asks to see their premises, Laurence alarms Sean with talk of a remote holiday, and Dee-Dee is stunned to learn of Damon's arrest.

Peter's thrilled when he wins a bet with Carla that sees him trade up from an onion bhaji to a motorbike. But the arrangement lands him in trouble with the police. Carla tells Stephen to resurrect the deal with Rufus but Rufus isn't interested. Rufus collapses after taking drugs, and when a sex worker arrives, Stephen starts scheming...

Hearing Sarah is now head of design, a furious Stephen spikes Carla's drinks with LSD and meddles with her things, so that Peter worries Carla's psychosis is returning. Processing Sarah's admission that she doesn't want a baby, Adam insists he understands her need for a career and says he'll raise the issue again in six months.

In court, Max is handed a six-month custodial sentence and he tells David he doesn't want visitors. Then a group of lads make it clear they will make Max's life hell. Nervous Billy tells Paul he still has feelings for him, but then Paul is ploughed down by the Underworld van, driven by a drugged-up Carla, and rushed to A&E...

When David hears Max has been beaten up, he hits the bottle. Maria is sympathetic but reels when David tries to kiss her! Shona finds out and tells David they're done. Stephen drugs Carla to stop her working. Alya is triggered when she encounters a man who's been accused of stabbing someone. Later, she and Ryan end up smooching.

Maria assures Shona that David's pass was nothing. Alya visits Max and writes a victim impact statement ahead of Blake's sentencing. Billy and Paul tell Todd they're together. Daisy is bombarded by messages from Justin. After reporting it to PC Scott, Daisy learns the copper has liked her pics on social media... Spider toys with jailed Griff.

When Daisy spies Justin with a bunch of flowers, she flips and punches him! Later, the barmaid is accused of assault. Daryan learns his brother has made it to the UK. Stephen informs Elaine he can repay her loan in full. Stephen asks Sarah to convince Carla that she needs more time off to recover. Gemma receives a huge gas bill.

When Stephen tries to oust Carla from the factory, she finds out and fires him. Later, he agrees to buy the Redbank apartment with Elaine. Daisy is appalled when she takes delivery of some wedding-cake samples and realises Justin's the driver. Paul tries to return to work but a concerned Ed sends him home.

Hearing his hand could take around 12 weeks to heal, Paul decides to sue Carla. Realising Carla wasn't insured to drive the van, Peter offers £15K but will Paul accept? Stephen drugs Carla's tea, but as he makes a work presentation, he starts sweating and experiencing blurred vision and it's clear he drank the laced cuppa.

Amy and Aaron get drunk and kiss, but Amy pulls away, guilt-ridden. Later, they play drinking games and when Amy falls into bed comatose, Aaron climbs in next to her... When Carla berates Stephen for his failed presentation, he's furious and goes to buy more drugs. But the dealers pocket his cash and laugh at him, and Stephen sees red.

Daisy meets her mum for lunch, but when Christina introduces her new boyfriend, Daisy's horrified to realise it's her stalker, Justin! Fiz accuses Beth of slapping Hope... With no memory of the night before, a hung-over Amy's left distraught when Aaron admits they slept together, knowing she was far too drunk to have consented.

A deluded Justin continues to meddle in Daisy's life, but things take a terrifying turn when Daisy then finds her stalker standing in the living room at No.1! Amy desperately tries to avoid Aaron. Meanwhile, as Kirk gives Beth the cold shoulder, contrite Beth begs Fiz to give Hope a written letter of apology.

Making out that he was as drunk as she was, Aaron begs Amy not to tell Summer that they slept together. But will Amy end up reporting Aaron for raping her? It's the day of Daisy's Stalking Protection Order hearing but Justin tries to persuade the judge there's been a misunderstanding and that he and Daisy are friends!
Daisy receives a warning from Justin's sister, Tim goes behind Faye's back in order to see his granddaughter, and Glenda chaperones Beth at her meeting with Marco.
Stephen spikes Carla's drink during an important client meeting, Sarah has an idea of how to help Nick, and Daisy opens up about living in constant fear.
Stephen lets himself into Carla's flat while she sleeps, Dee-Dee is appalled by Adam's offer to represent Damon, and Evelyn invites Roy to her birthday gathering.
Sarah shares a drink with the enemy, Rufus threatens to expose Stephen, Roy and Evelyn clear the air, and Glenda auditions for Daisy.
Evelyn blames Roy for Cerberus's condition, Sarah implores Damon to steer clear of Nick and Adam, and Paul comes to Gemma's rescue.
Paul makes a worrying discovery about his injury, Christina arranges a surprise for Daisy's hen party, and Roy accepts responsibility for Evelyn's heartache.
Daisy's perfect wedding day is sabotaged by Justin, Simon notices something amiss with Amy, and Paul admits to Billy that he has spent every penny of the loan money.
Aaron makes a confession to Summer, Amy shares her torment with Tracy, Stephen lies to his workforce, yet again, and Brian celebrates the result of his DNA test.
Amy shocks Summer with the truth about Aaron, Michael confronts Stephen over his deception, and Beth ignores Glenda's advice to steer clear of old flame Marco.
Tracy refuses to remain silent while Amy is suffering, Faye invites Craig to meet Miley, and Paul has no intention of becoming Dee-Dee's charity case.
Paul reels at the prospect of a terrifying diagnosis, Amy's U-turn grants Aaron a reprieve, Damon makes a play for Sarah, and Craig's blunder leaves Miley unimpressed.
Paul picks an unlikely confidant in a bid to earn cash, Sarah makes a demand of Damon, Michael puts his case for a cut of Stephen's profits, and Glenda reconnects with an old pal.
A mischievous Damon infiltrates Sarah's business meeting, Stephen tries to keep Michael and Rufus apart, and Glenda decides to buy one of Estelle's franchises.
Sarah despairs when Damon walks free from court, Michael resents being overlooked by Stephen, Roy receives an inheritance by default, and Eileen discovers that George lied to her.
Michael is in for a shock upon arriving at Rufus's house, Damon persuades Nick and Leanne to seek a late licence for the bistro, and Glenda holds her first drama class.
Jason enters a not guilty plee.Ryan tells Alya he still loves her.Beth sees her flirty ex Marco.Roy makes a sudden worrying exit from a Salsa class with Evelyn.

Ryan is horrified when he finally gets to look at his facial injuries for the first time, as Daisy is trying to keep the truth about Crystal from him. Faye and Beth catch each other on dates with their exes. Stu's heartbroken when he finds out Eliza is being bullied about her jailbird Mum. Roy decides to go to hospital for tests.
After his skin graft surgery Ryan prepares to go home. Fay's torn when Jackson asks her to move south with him and then Craig proposes! Kirk continues to cold shoulder Beth.

Nina's surprise party goes ahead and Amy admits to Summer and Aadi that Aaron did rape her. Damon tells Paul to dispose of Rufus's stolen car- that doesn't go well. Sam offers to teach Eliza how to play chess- but jealous Hope is furious.

Summer finds Amy passed out in the street due to an alcohol binge and tells Tracy and Steve the truth about the rape. Eliza gets a place at Weatherfield High. Paul's world is turned upside down when he's diagnosed with Motor Neurone Disease.

Stephen is approached by two young drug-dealers who tell him they know what he did to Rufus and want 10k to keep quiet. George starts model making to keep his mind off work related stress...Eileen is not happy.
Tim resolves to stop Elaine from eloping with Stephen, Adam's birthday plans make Sarah uneasy, Dee-Dee forces Paul to confront his future, and Amy suffers a panic attack on a bus.
